discovery.regexRule: Static re.* calls whose literal pattern uses Python-only constructs (lookaround, \Z, backreferences, atomic groups, possessive quantifiers, \G) must be mapped. Dynamic f-string patterns and user-supplied query regexes are separate requirements.
discovery.testCaseRule: Each top-level test function is one mapping; literal @pytest.mark.parametrize lists multiply its case count. Dynamic parametrization would be reported as unknown rather than silently frozen.
discovery.fixturePolicy: Durable inventory fixtures live in tools/apk-lab/migration/fixtures/inventory. The .source-repo directory is hidden so pytest default norecursedirs skips its test_*.py; fixture Python files start with "# ruff: noqa" and "# fmt: off" so Ruff check/format do not rewrite hash-pinned bytes; Prettier patterns cover only Markdown under tools/apk-lab, not these JSON/TOML/Python/text files. Manifest SHA-256/byte inventory is enforced by cargo tests; intentional fixture edits require a manifest refresh.
scannerLimitations: Discovers argparse structure from literal add_parser/add_argument/add_subparsers/add_mutually_exclusive_group/set_defaults calls. Computed argument lists, loops, custom actions, parser parents=, prefix_chars/allow_abbrev/argument_default and argparse branching outside those calls are not discovered.
Non-literal defaults/choices/types are frozen as expr:<source> markers, not evaluated. Help text, metavar, deprecation and formatter details are intentionally not part of the checked contract.
Subparser aliases are recorded on the owning command; invoking an alias is not expanded as a separate command id.

Test discovery covers top-level pytest test functions and literal parametrize lists. unittest classes, pytest_generate_tests, dynamic parametrization and fixtures do not increase the frozen case count.

Consumer discovery is a repository text scan for apk_lab tokens outside the implementation/tests/migration harness. Dynamic importlib loading, generated files outside the listed roots and string-concatenated module names are not discovered.

Wire discovery covers literal keys in models to_dict methods, named CLI/CI handler dict literals and dataclass annotations. dict(**kwargs), computed keys and serializer overrides outside those constructs are not discovered.

Regex discovery covers literal re.* patterns using Python-only constructs. Adjacent string-literal concatenation is inspected only through its first literal. Flags, dynamic f-string patterns and user-supplied query regexes are listed separately in regexRequirements.

pythonOnlyRegexes.behavior: Python lookahead split. Rust regex split without lookaround yields different delimiters; candidate must scan block starts explicitly.

regexRequirements.behavior: Pattern is compiled with re.IGNORECASE by default; -s/--case-sensitive disables it. Invalid patterns surface as Strings search error.

re.compile with re.IGNORECASE; invalid regex surfaces as Manifest inspection error.
